Coram : HEMANT GUPTA*, V. RAMASUBRAMANIAN
Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015 – s.94(2)(ii) – Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Rules, 2007 – r.12(3) – U.P Panchayat Raj Act, 1947 – U.P. Panchayat Raj (Maintenance of Family Register) Rules, 1970 – in conflict with law by Additional Sessions Judge – Order set aside by High Court, appellant ordered to stand trial as an adult – On appeal, held: Plea of juvenility has to be raised in a bonafide and truthful manner – To seek juvenility, if the reliance is on a document
Decision Date : 15-02-2022 | Case No : CRIMINAL APPEAL No. 207/2022 | Disposal Nature : Dismissed | Bench : 2 Judges
